title: AirQo Website
subtitle: Web experience for an air quality platform serving Africa
description: The main public-facing website for AirQo, a platform providing air quality data and insights across African communities. The website serves as the primary entry point for communities, researchers, and policymakers seeking air quality information.
problem: AirQo needed a modern, accessible website that communicates its mission and data products to diverse audiences — from community members checking local air quality to researchers accessing detailed monitoring data. The site needed to perform well on low-bandwidth connections common across Africa.
role: Contributed to the frontend development of the AirQo website, building responsive components, implementing internationalization supporting 40+ languages including African languages, and optimizing performance for constrained networks.
approach: Built with a focus on accessibility and performance — responsive design optimized for mobile-first usage, lazy-loaded data visualizations, and a multilingual content system supporting over 40 languages. Implemented internationalization workflows that accommodate African languages with limited tooling support.
hardestDecision: Implementing internationalization for African languages — many lack standard digital tooling, requiring custom solutions for text direction, font support, and content management that respects linguistic nuances.
outcome: Live at airqo.net, serving as AirQo's primary digital presence across African communities with multilingual support.
whatIdChange: Would implement progressive web app capabilities for offline access, add voice-based interaction for low-literacy users, and build a community-contributed translation system.
